as_told.title: Kirsan Ilyumzhinov says aliens took him onto a spaceship in 1997

plain: A man named Kanan Il Yum Xenov, the president of Kalmykia, a Buddhist republic in Russia that borders Dagestan, says he was taken by aliens, or invited onto a spaceship, while he was the sitting president. Michels says he interviewed the man himself and tells the story twice, once giving the year as 1997. If true, it would mean a serving head of a region had such an encounter.
